text:
maria: Heads-up — last night we saw a big cost delta on the us-west GPU pool after the 02:00 maintenance. Anyone else notice a large overprovision? :eyes:
jon: saw it. batch-runner queue spawned extra jobs when spots dipped and autoscaler didn't drain fast enough
maria: can you paste the metric? cost spike numbers?
jon: billing snapshot: additional ~$4.6k over 6h, GPU hours up ~28% vs baseline. infra graphs show us-west-gpu-spot scaled to ~420 nodes at 02:10
ali: matches interruption logs — provider signaled preemptions around 02:05 and autoscaler created on-demand fallbacks which then remained up because several pods had podAntiAffinity and couldn't pack down
leah: is this because batch jobs are tolerant of termination and immediately respawn without backoff? we should prefer lower parallelism or exponential backoff during interruptions
maria: proposed mitigation: an off-peak schedule that favors spot for batch jobs 00:00-06:00, and reduce interactive burst windows. also add a preemptible drain hook to avoid immediate on-demand fallback
jon: agree. initial knobs to tune:
- queue-priority: interactive=high, batch=low
- max-on-demand-burst: cap to 15% of total pool
- drain-grace: 120s for spot nodes
ali: add autoscaler behavior: prefer mixed-instance pools (heterogeneous instance sizes) and only create on-demand when sustained deficit > 10m
maria: can we run ops commands now to mitigate while we roll configs? throttle batch queue?
leah: yes — you can reduce batch concurrency: `kubectl -n ml scale deploy batch-runner --replicas=3` and set redis worker env: `RQ_WORKERS=2`
opsbot: alert: us-west1 spot-flap detected — 2026-03-12T02:04Z — interruptions=72 — fallback-created=124
jon: thanks opsbot
maria: someone open a short RFC: include timeline, cost delta, and proposed changes (drain_grace, burst_cap, queue_priority, off-peak shift)
ali: I'll draft and include a Playbook snippet for interruption handling, will post link then
leah: rollout plan: canary in eu-west1 first (lighter traffic) then us-west if green
maria: timeline: draft today, canary tomorrow morning, full roll by Friday if green
jon: PR to autoscaler config ready — referencing `autoscaler/v2/mixed-pools.yaml` with env `MAX_ONDEMAND_BURST=0.15`
maria: ping when PR is up
ali: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/autoscaler/pull/842 — includes drain hook:
```
preemptible-drain:
  grace_seconds: 120
  notify: /hooks/drain-notify
```
leah: looks good. schedule canary 08:00 CET
maria: i'll update billing & incident tracker for chargeback :thumbsup:
jon: small follow-up: add eviction metrics to cost dashboards to correlate preemptions vs on-demand spinups
maria: agreed — add to Optimize dashboard and create alert if spillover cost > $500/hr
sre-bot: Created ticket IR-5234: "Nightly spot flap -> on-demand spillover" assigned to ali
maria: closing loop — we'll reconvene after canary results
